pages.title: Quark-Gluon Plasma
pages.text: The state of matter that filled the universe for its first few microseconds. Protons and neutrons have melted, and quarks and gluons flow freely as an almost perfect liquid with barely any viscosity. It is the hottest thing I have ever bottled, and it pours like light.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Colliding neutronium nuclei in the Quark-Gluon Collider, cooled with superfluid helium between runs, I saw jets quench as if passing through a thick liquid. The protons had melted. Heavy-ion physics in a flask.
